designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system crafts an intimate, archival sanctuary for personal media—family heirlooms, travel photography, spoken memories, and handwritten scans. Rooted in the tactile warmth of sun-bleached Tuscan villas, worn leather folios, and sun-baked terra cotta, the aesthetic channels an elevated nostalgia that rejects cold, clinical cloud storage.

The emotional tone balances reverence with domestic comfort: calm, secure, artisanal, and timeless. The design movement marries **Warm Editorial Minimalism** with **Tactile Heritage Textures**. Flat digital surfaces give way to layered paper-weight planes, debossed accents, and natural sunlight color temperature. Every interaction evokes opening a personal lockbox or turning the heavy parchment pages of an ancestral album.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon a balanced **12-column responsive fluid grid** with an emphasis on generous margins that simulate the white matting around fine art photography.

- **Desktop (1024px and above)**: 12 columns, 32px gutters, maximum container width capped at 1280px (`80rem`). Generous page padding (`48px` to `72px`) guarantees that media collections feel curated rather than congested.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8 columns, 24px gutters, 32px margins. Side drawers collapse to icon rails or bottom panels.
- **Mobile (under 768px)**: 4 columns, 16px gutters, 16px page margin. Cards convert into a single or dual-column masonry layout reminiscent of a pocket travel diary.

Vertical rhythm relies strictly on 8px base increments, allowing photographic grids and accompanying metadata to align precisely across adjacent viewports.

## Elevation & Depth

To remain faithful to physical parchment and archival cases, avoid cold, neutral-gray drop shadows. Elevation is achieved through **warm-tinted ambient shadows** paired with **subtle parchment-tier shifts**:

- **Tier 0 (Base Canvas)**: Flat `#faf6f0`.
- **Tier 1 (Resting Tiles & Cards)**: Surface `#f3ece1` with a warm cast shadow: `0 2px 8px -2px rgba(59, 34, 25, 0.06), 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(59, 34, 25, 0.04)`.
- **Tier 2 (Hovered Cards & Dropdowns)**: Surface `#ffffff` or light parchment, elevated with `0 10px 24px -4px rgba(156, 65, 38, 0.12), 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(59, 34, 25, 0.04)`. The terracotta tint introduces atmospheric sunlit warmth under active objects.
- **Tier 3 (Modals, Lightboxes & Vault Drawers)**: High elevation supported by a backdrop scrim tinted in deep umber: `rgba(59, 34, 25, 0.65)` with an 8px blur. Modal box shadow: `0 20px 48px -8px rgba(59, 34, 25, 0.25)`.
- **Ghost Borders**: Where shadows are undesirable, separation is created using 1px solid `#e2d5c3`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid Rustic Terracotta (`#9c4126`) with crisp parchment text (`#faf6f0`). Subtle bevel highlight on top border (`1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)`). Hover triggers a transition to deep terracotta (`#82351e`).
- **Secondary / Accent**: Radiant Sunset Marigold (`#f59e0b`) background with Deep Umber text (`#3b2219`). Dedicated to high-significance tasks (e.g., "Add Memory", "Unlock Vault").
- **Tertiary / Outlined**: 1px border in `#9c4126`, transparent fill, terracotta text. Hover introduces a delicate fill of `rgba(156, 65, 38, 0.06)`.

### Chips & Filter Tags
- Set on `#ebe1d3` base with `#785e54` typography in uppercase `label-sm`.
- Selected state turns solid Terracotta (`#9c4126`) with parchment text (`#faf6f0`) and an inset micro-dot in Marigold (`#f59e0b`).

### Media Cards & Folios
- Wrapped in light parchment (`#f3ece1`) with a 1px border of `#e2d5c3`.
- Aspect ratios strictly framed (3:2, 4:5, 1:1) with a 6px internal matting border evoking physical photo prints.
- Bottom metadata pane displays the title in `Newsreader` italic, timestamped with a tiny marigold lock or star indicator.

### Lists & Timeline Entries
- Border-separated by 1px rules in `#ebe1d3`.
- Timeline nodes feature a vertical 2px guide in `#9c4126` punctuated by marigold date markers. Hovering highlights the row in `rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08)`.

### Inputs & Search
- Recessed background `#ebe1d3` with a 1px bottom accent border in `#9c4126`.
- Focus shifts input field to crisp `#faf6f0` with a dual-layer focus glow in Sunset Marigold (`0 0 0 3px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3)`).

### Specialized Domain Components
- **Media Lightbox & Audio Player**: Umber velvet dock (`#3b2219`) equipped with Sunset Marigold scrub bars, terracotta waveforms, and delicate brass-toned icons.
- **Biometric / Vault Passcode Pinpad**: Tactile, squared keypad buttons with soft parchment deboss effects and golden confirmation rings.

## Brand & Style

Every interaction evokes opening a personal lockbox or turning the heavy parchment pages of an ancestral album.

## Colors

The palette executes a precise 60-30-10 distribution, evoking sun-baked earth and golden-hour light:

- **Linen Parchment Neutral (`#faf6f0`) — 60%**: Dominates the canvas as the base canvas and card backdrop. It reduces eye fatigue, mimics aged paper stock, and provides an organic, non-clinical ground.
- **Rustic Terracotta (`#9c4126`) — 30%**: The structural anchor. Used for navigation bars, category tags, primary interactive triggers, active timeline states, and framing borders.
- **Sunset Marigold (`#f59e0b`) — 10%**: High-frequency, concentrated radiance. Reserved for key action items (CTAs, favorite bookmarks, security tokens, audio playback thumbs, active memory indicators).
- **Deep Umber / Tertiary (`#3b2219`)**: Grounding ink tone for high-legibility typographic hierarchy and dense vector iconography.

### Functional Roles
- **Surface**: `#faf6f0` (Base parchment)
- **Surface Container (Muted)**: `#f3ece1` (Secondary card backing, shelf rows)
- **Surface Container High**: `#ebe1d3` (Raised dialogs, media toolbars)
- **Text Primary**: `#3b2219` (Deep espresso ink)
- **Text Muted**: `#785e54` (Faded sepia)
- **Accent Glow**: `#f59e0b` at 15% opacity for focus rings and selection halos.

## Typography

The type system juxtaposes the literary intimacy of **Newsreader** with the clean, contemporary legibility of **Manrope**.

- **Editorial Display & Headlines (`Newsreader`)**: Evokes antique book setting, archival catalog indexes, and preserved journals. Used with italics for chapter years, poetic subheadings, and contextual memory titles.
- **Interface & Body (`Manrope`)**: Handles metadata, camera EXIF readouts, encryption keys, and continuous narrative body copy. Its open geometry keeps dense catalog interfaces effortlessly legible against linen backgrounds.
